title: Decide how the Mac runner should budget long focused suites
outcome: Decide whether to retain or change the outer 30-minute Mac runner wrapper budget for long focused selections, based on observed compile and suite timings.
acceptance: Identify who owns the outer wrapper and document when its 1,800-second budget starts, what it terminates, and how this differs from the standard launcher's native terminal verdict.
Record a decision to retain, reconfigure, or replace this wrapper budget, with observed compile and suite timings and the effect on legitimate long-running selections.
